name: User
definition: A registered participant of the community platform, represented by one row in the users table and identified by users.Id.
scope: Community platform account and activity analysis

name: User Identifier
definition: The numeric identifier that uniquely identifies a user across the community database. It is the value carried by users.Id and by every column that references a user.
scope: Any analysis that identifies a user by number, or joins user-attributed records together

name: Post
definition: A unit of community content. The posts table holds several kinds of content distinguished by the post type, including questions, answers, and tag wiki material.
scope: Content-level analysis across all content kinds

name: Question Post
definition: A post that asks a question. Questions carry the title, tag list, view/answer/favorite counters and may have answers attached.
scope: Question-level analysis, tagging, and view/answer metrics

name: Answer Post
definition: A post that answers a question. An answer is attached to its parent question and may be designated as the accepted answer.
scope: Answer-level analysis and question/answer relationship analysis

name: Tag Wiki Post
definition: A post that carries tag documentation rather than community question/answer content, covering tag wiki excerpts, tag wikis, and orphaned tag wikis.
scope: Tag documentation content analysis

name: Tag
definition: A topical label used to classify questions. Each tag has a bare name, a usage counter, and optional references to its excerpt and wiki content.
scope: Topic classification and tag-level analysis

name: Comment
definition: A short piece of feedback attached to a post. A comment has its own author, score and text, and always belongs to exactly one post.
scope: Comment-level analysis and post discussion analysis

name: Vote
definition: A recorded reaction cast on a post, distinguished by a vote type such as up vote, down vote or favorite. A vote always belongs to a post; the casting user is recorded only for part of the rows.
scope: Voting and content-rating analysis

name: Badge Award
definition: A single award of a named achievement badge to a user on a given date. The same badge name can be awarded to many users on many dates.
scope: Achievement and gamification analysis

name: Post Link
definition: A recorded relationship between two posts, such as one post being linked to or marked as a duplicate of another. It always references a source post and a related post.
scope: Cross-post relationship analysis

name: Post Revision
definition: A recorded event in a post's edit history, such as initial creation, title change, body change or tag change. Each event stores the acting user and the value recorded at that point.
scope: Edit history and revision analysis

name: Post Score
definition: The net rating a post has accumulated, reflecting the balance of positive and negative votes received. The value is a stored counter, not a raw vote count, and can be negative.
scope: Content quality and popularity ranking

name: View Count
definition: The number of times a post has been viewed. Recorded only for content that can be browsed as a standalone page.
scope: Traffic and reach analysis

name: Favorite Count
definition: The number of times a post has been marked as a favorite/bookmark by users. It is a stored counter and is absent for a large share of posts. It is often used as a proxy for how valuable or noteworthy a post is.
scope: Content value and bookmarking analysis

name: Answer Count
definition: The number of answers a question post has received, stored as a counter on the question itself.
scope: Question responsiveness analysis

name: Comment Count
definition: The number of comments attached to a post, stored as a counter on the post itself. A value of zero indicates a post with no comments.
scope: Discussion volume analysis; filtering posts without comments

name: Comment Score
definition: The net rating of a single comment, reflecting the balance of positive and negative votes on that comment. Observed values are non-negative in this data set.
scope: Comment quality or usefulness ranking

name: User Reputation
definition: The accumulated reputation points of a user, stored as a single running total on the user record rather than derived from individual vote records.
scope: User standing and experience analysis

name: User Up Votes
definition: A cumulative per-user counter of positive voting activity stored on the user record. It is a profile total and does not reconcile with individual vote records in the votes table.
scope: User engagement analysis; average up votes across a user set

name: User Down Votes
definition: A cumulative per-user counter of negative voting activity stored on the user record, provided as an aggregate total rather than a per-vote record.
scope: User engagement analysis

name: User Age
definition: The self-reported age of a user, stored as a whole number of years on the user record. It is provided only by a minority of users.
scope: Demographic analysis of users; average user age

name: Tag Usage Count
definition: The number of questions that carry a given tag, stored as a counter on the tag record.
scope: Tag popularity analysis

name: Post Title
definition: The headline text of a post. Questions always carry a title; other content kinds do not.
scope: Locating or displaying content by its headline

name: Post Body
definition: The main prose content of a post, holding the question text, answer text, or the documentation text of a tag wiki post.
scope: Displaying or searching post content

name: Comment Text
definition: The prose content of a single comment, used when a question searches for or displays what a commenter wrote.
scope: Searching and displaying comment wording

name: User Display Name
definition: The human-readable name a user shows on the platform. It is a display label, not a unique key, and the same label can belong to several distinct users.
scope: Identifying users in questions phrased with a person's name

name: Post Tags
definition: The set of topical labels attached to a question post, serialized into a single text value on the post as a concatenation of bracketed tag names.
scope: Identifying which topics a question belongs to

name: Tag Name
definition: The bare name of a tag, stored without any surrounding decoration, used when reasoning about or filtering on a single topic label.
scope: Naming and filtering individual topics

name: Badge Name
definition: The name of an achievement badge. Names are free-text labels with fixed capitalization and a broad but finite set of distinct values.
scope: Filtering badge awards by achievement type

name: Post Type
definition: A coded classification on each post that determines what kind of content the row represents, such as question, answer or tag documentation. It governs which other columns are populated.
scope: Separating content kinds and interpreting nullable content columns

name: Vote Type
definition: A coded classification describing what kind of reaction a vote record represents, such as an up vote, a down vote or a favorite marking.
scope: Interpreting or filtering voting activity by reaction kind

name: Post Creation Date
definition: The timestamp at which a post was first created. It is the anchor for all time filtering and year-based grouping of community content.
scope: Time filtering and year-based grouping of posts

name: User Account Creation Date
definition: The timestamp at which a user's account was created on the platform.
scope: Account cohort and registration-time analysis

name: Last Access Date
definition: The most recent timestamp at which a user visited the platform, recorded on the user record.
scope: User recency and activity-window analysis

name: Badge Award Date
definition: The timestamp at which a badge was awarded to a user.
scope: Time-based analysis of badge awards

name: Post Link Creation Date
definition: The timestamp at which a relationship between two posts was recorded.
scope: Time-based analysis of cross-post linking activity

name: Post Owner
definition: The user who authored a post and is recorded as its owner. Ownership is the basis for attributing posts to a person, and may be unset for imported or anonymous content.
scope: Attributing posts to authors; counting posts owned by a user

name: Last Editor
definition: The user who most recently edited a post. Editing is optional, so many posts have no recorded editor and the post owner is the only attributed user.
scope: Edit attribution and editorial activity analysis

name: Comment Author
definition: The user who wrote a comment. The author is identified by a user reference on the comment record.
scope: Attributing comments to users; naming the user who commented

name: Vote Author
definition: The user who cast a vote. The casting user is recorded only for a minority of vote rows, so votes cannot always be attributed to a person.
scope: Attributing votes to users; counting a user's votes

name: Tag Excerpt Source Post
definition: The post that holds a tag's short explanatory excerpt. It is referenced from the tag record, and many tags have no such reference at all.
scope: Resolving the documentation content behind a tag name
